text:
tess: quick check on a proposal for the left rail: i'm trying to reason about ephemeral UI state vs shareable deep links. sketch: https://figma.com/file/left-rail-ephemeral (frames A-C). key goals: no surprise scroll jumps, copyable 'view' links when needed, and clear a11y behaviour. thoughts?
omar: looks sensible. main question: how do we persist which groups are open? users expect deep links to restore context, but we also don't want to bake temporary toggles into permanent URLs.
tess: exactly. my thought: canonical deep links = path segments (/w/:ws/nav/teams/slug), ephemeral UI state (open groups, pin) = history state or sessionStorage. offer an explicit "Copy view (with open groups)" to create a shareable URL that encodes UI state.rene: accessibility: if we snapshot open groups into a shared URL, ensure the page fires an aria-live notice when restoring so SR users know the nav expanded. Also keyboard: group headers must be tabbable and respond to Space/Enter to toggle.
sylvia: UX nit: when restoring a deep link that lands deep in a long list, avoid jump-to-top behaviour. prefer smooth scrollIntoView with focus movement, but announce change. maybe focus the target item, then call:
```js
item.focus();
item.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center', behavior: 'smooth' });
```
omar: good call. also add a tiny delay before trapping focus if animations run long, otherwise focus gets lost.
tess: for the shareable view URL, proposal: when user hits "Copy view (include open groups)", we generate a short encoded fragment rather than query params, e.g. /w/x/nav/teams/slug#view=G:teams-42;open=teams-42,projects-7. fragment avoids server-side routing confusion and is easy to decode client-side.rene: fragments are okay, but make sure we don't expose PII. encode and limit expiry? maybe add a note in the copy toast: "Shared view may include UI state; remove if private".
sylvia: copy text suggestions: button label = "Copy view (includes open groups)", toast = "Link copied — includes open sections". for pin CTA use "Keep section open" label in tooltip.
omar: implementation detail: store ephemeral state in history.replaceState so back/forward preserves toggles. sessionStorage can be fallback for full reload. example:
```js
const state = { open: ['teams-42'], pinned: { 'teams-42': true } };
history.replaceState(state, '', window.location.pathname + window.location.hash);
// on load, if history.state present -> restore UI
```
tess: perfect. one more: breadcrumbs should always render the canonical path (workspace > team > page) and not reflect ephemeral names. Breadcrumb links should use the canonical path segments so copy/paste from breadcrumb gives stable links.rene: a11y checklist items: 1) aria-pressed on pin buttons, 2) aria-expanded on headers, 3) aria-controls to reference group lists, 4) live region announces for restore/restore-complete, 5) keyboard-only flows covered in tests. i'll add these to the accessibility doc.
sylvia: small visual: when a shareable fragment is loaded, show a subtle banner: "This view includes open sections" with a dismiss action. helps set expectations.
omar: curious about garbage in url fragments if users keep copying them around. maybe short id + server-side mapping would be cleaner, but that's more effort. fragments are low-cost MVP.
tess: decision for now: 1) canonical deep links = path segments; 2) ephemeral UI = history.state + sessionStorage fallback; 3) provide explicit "Copy view (includes open groups)" which encodes UI state in URL fragment; 4) breadcrumbs link to canonical path; 5) a11y live announcements & keyboard semantics; 6) subtle banner when loading a fragment.
kb-bot: preview built: left-rail-ephemeral-preview deployed to staging at 2025-02-14T15:00Z :rocket: (link: https://staging.redwood.ai/preview/left-rail-ephemeral)
omar: i'll prototype the fragment encoder and a small utility to prune sensitive keys.rene: i'll wire up the a11y tests and a Storybook story that simulates fragment restore.
sylvia: i'll craft the copy strings and the banner design.
tess: thanks all. i'll update the figma and add a small PR checklist here. next: omar + rene to pair on prototype.
